name: clear-day-for-parents
description: Skills for families: find licensed daycare near you, compare centers and plan how to pay, using public licensing records.

defaultPrompt: Find licensed daycare centers near me.
Compare two daycare centers side by side.
Help me plan how to pay for child care.
interface.longDescription: Skills for parents and guardians (adults) who are looking for child care: find licensed daycare centers near you, compare them side by side, prepare questions for a tour and plan how to pay, using public licensing records. You can also ask the assistant to request a tour; Clear Day then emails you a confirmation link, and nothing is sent to the provider until you confirm. This plugin is for adults, not for children.
